items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Dude, he used to call him Dude, but I don't know the rest of his name.

ctx.x: This is reel four of Tom Albert, May the 7th, 1962. Now we're talking about that corner player. He used to go take Kolaos.
Dude, he used to call him Dude, but I don't know the rest of his name.
